text: The future of AI is a topic that many people discuss today. Most AI systems we use now are designed for specific tasks, such as translating languages or recommending videos. However, researchers are working on artificial general intelligence (AGI), a type of AI that could think and learn like humans. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving serious medical problems or helping to fight climate change. At the same time, it carries risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some predict it within ten years, while others believe it is much further away.
